fato_historico: 1278: Trần Thánh Tông, the second emperor of the Trần dynasty, decides to pass the throne to his crown prince Trần Khâm and take up the post of Retired Emperor.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to consider the beauty of transition. Just as a wise leader might gracefully pass the torch to focus on inner peace, you may feel empowered to delegate tasks or shift your focus. It is a good time to cultivate tranquility and appreciate the solid ground beneath your feet as you prepare for new growth.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in knowing when to evolve and embrace a new chapter.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of abundance and karmic balance in life.
conselho: Trust your intuition and release burdens that no longer serve your peaceful journey.
